integrity: The complete proof is given in RESULT.md. Finite exhaustive verification corroborates but does not replace the mathematical proof. Standard Chebyshev product distances and inclusion-exclusion are credited, not claimed original.
scientific_limitations: The proved family consists only of finite strong products of at least two paths. The limiting law applies to uniform path powers with q tending to infinity and d/q^2 converging in the extended nonnegative reals. No independent external validation or definitive literature-priority certification is claimed.
title: Triameter and a complete extremal-triple census for strong products of paths
